answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Jade carver carved cameo seal witnessed by the crystal register. It demands each carved cameo is a measured facet angle plus a guild signature, so a farm must carve a hundred real jades by hand, and the voyage is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the kernel is that the farm's unit economics never work. The saffron is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
